name: Hatake: Latent Lightning Release Adept III

system.description:
Bloodline Point Cost: 5

(You must have Latent Advanced Chakra Control II & Latent White Chakra I) Beginning at 11th level, When you would cast a jutsu with the Lightning Release Keyword and an Overcharge effect, you can choose to spend an amount of White chakra equal to its rank to fulfill the Overcharge requirements to gain their effects. (D-Rank/C-Rank: 1 White Chakra (WC), B-Rank/A-Rank: 2 WC, S-Rank: 3 WC)
